transport: gRPC over plaintext HTTP/2 · same service as the dish dialect: package SpaceX.API.Device, service Device, rpc Handle(Request) returns (Response) · dish at 192.168.100.1:9200, router at 192.168.1.1:9000 (router default subnet 192.168.1.1/24) · no TLS, no authentication (SpaceX's demo.py uses grpc.insecure_channel)
blocks: Request oneof: 6000 get_diagnostics (GetDiagnosticsRequest, empty). Response oneof: 6000 wifi_get_diagnostics, 6001 dish_get_diagnostics. DishGetDiagnosticsResponse: 1 id · 2 hardware_version · 3 software_version · 4 utc_offset_s · 5 alerts · 6 disablement_code · 7 hardware_self_test · 8 location · 9 alignment_stats · 10 stowed · 11 hardware_self_test_codes · 14 overage_rate_limited. Alerts sub-message fields 1–10: dish_is_heating, dish_thermal_throttle, dish_thermal_shutdown, power_supply_thermal_throttle, motors_stuck, mast_not_near_vertical, slow_ethernet_speeds, software_install_pending, moving_too_fast_for_policy, obstructed. Location sub-message fields 1–7: enabled, latitude, longitude, altitude_meters, uncertainty_meters_valid, uncertainty_meters, gps_time_s. AlignmentStats fields 1–4: boresight_azimuth_deg, boresight_elevation_deg, desired_boresight_azimuth_deg, desired_boresight_elevation_deg. WifiGetDiagnosticsResponse: 1 id · 2 hardware_version · 3 software_version · 4 networks (repeated Network: 1 domain, 2 ipv4, 3 ipv6, 10 clients_ethernet, 11 clients_2ghz, 12 clients_5ghz).

gotchas: This is the ONLY vendor-documented local API for a Starlink terminal, and it reports nothing the contract can hold. That is the headline: the map with the best provenance is the least useful, and the map the shipped driver uses has no vendor document behind it at all. Minimum software versions are hard requirements, stated by SpaceX: WiFi router > 2023.55 (late December 2023), user terminal > 2023.51.0 (early January 2024). Below those the call returns UNIMPLEMENTED — not an error a driver should retry.

Location.enabled gates the rest of the Location message: 'If location is not enabled, the remainder of this message is invalid.' unmappedReports: Every field in this dialect. Nothing it returns maps to a MetricKind, which is the finding: SpaceX's only officially supported local API reports zero contract metrics., Dish alerts — the same ten booleans that have no MetricKind and no ValueKind in the dish dialect, here in a vendor-blessed form: dish_is_heating, dish_thermal_throttle, dish_thermal_shutdown, power_supply_thermal_throttle, motors_stuck, mast_not_near_vertical, slow_ethernet_speeds, software_install_pending, moving_too_fast_for_policy, obstructed., disablement_code — 13 values including NO_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, TOO_FAR_FROM_SERVICE_ADDRESS, DATA_OVERAGE_SANDBOX_POLICY, ROAM_RESTRICTED, ACCOUNT_DISABLED. Vendor-documented with per-value prose, and no contract variant can hold it., hardware_self_test (NO_RESULT / PASSED / FAILED) plus 20 hardware_self_test_codes (CPU_VOLTAGE, DBF_T_DIE_0, EIRP, FEM_CUT, FUSE_AVS, GPS, IMU, PHY, TEMPERATURE, VTSENS …). No MetricKind for a self-test result., Location: latitude, longitude, altitude_meters, uncertainty_meters, gps_time_s. No MetricKind, and Unit has no degree or metre., AlignmentStats: current and desired boresight azimuth and elevation. No MetricKind and no Unit::Degree., stowed (bool) and overage_rate_limited (bool — 'consumed all purchased data … rate limited to 1mbps down and 0.5mbps down', vendor wording, including its own typo). Neither maps., utc_offset_s — 'approximate time zone of the device in relation to UTC'. Device metadata., Router side: clients_ethernet, clients_2ghz, clients_5ghz per network. Unit::Count exists but no MetricKind names a connected-client count. ipv4 / ipv6 CIDRs and network domain are metadata.
